description: Read ID3 tags (title, artist, album, year, genre, comment, track number) directly from an MP3 file's bytes. Prefers an ID3v2.3/2.4 header; falls back to a classic ID3v1/1.1 128-byte trailer. No audio library required.

mp3_base64.description: Base64-encoded MP3 file bytes, optionally prefixed with a data: URL scheme

name: read_id3_tags
